title: Wildlife & Animal Kingdom
subject: Biology & Animals
description: Fun facts about majestic beasts, ocean wonders, flying champions, and secret creature abilities.

questions.question: What is the largest living animal currently on planet Earth?
questions.fact: The Blue Whale can weigh up to 200 tons and its heart is as large as a small car!

questions.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.fact: An octopus has 3 hearts: two pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps blood through the body!

questions.question: Which bird is the fastest animal in the entire world when diving?
questions.fact: A Peregrine Falcon can exceed speeds of 320 km/h (200 mph) in a high-speed hunting dive!

questions.question: What is the only mammal capable of true sustained flight?
questions.fact: Bats flap their webbed finger-wings for true powered flight; flying squirrels only glide!

questions.question: What do giant pandas eat for roughly 99% of their daily diet?
questions.fact: Giant pandas spend up to 12 hours a day chewing through heaps of nutrient-rich bamboo.

questions.question: Which ocean creature sleeps with one eye open and half of its brain awake?
questions.fact: Dolphins use unihemispheric sleep so they can continue surfacing for air and stay alert for predators!

questions.question: What is a group of lions called?
questions.fact: A lion family group is called a pride, typically led by related females and a few strong males.

questions.question: Which animal has the longest neck in the world?
questions.fact: A giraffe's neck can reach up to 2 meters (6 feet) long, yet it still has only 7 cervical vertebrae—the same number as humans!

questions.question: Which of these animals is a marsupial that carries its young in a pouch?
questions.fact: Female kangaroos nurture tiny newborn joeys inside an abdominal front pouch.

questions.question: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.fact: Spiders are arachnids with 8 legs and two body segments, unlike 6-legged insects.

questions.question: What color is a polar bear's skin underneath its thick white fur?
questions.fact: A polar bear has jet-black skin to absorb heat from the sun, while its clear hollow hairs reflect light!

questions.question: Which of these birds cannot fly?
questions.fact: Penguins evolved flippers to swim gracefully through icy seas instead of flying in the air.

questions.question: What is the fastest land animal in the world over short sprints?
questions.fact: A cheetah can accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h (60 mph) in just 3 seconds!

questions.question: What do honeybees collect from blossoms to create sweet honey?
questions.fact: Bees sip sugary floral nectar and break it down with enzymes into honey in the hive.

questions.question: Which creature is known for being able to regenerate completely lost limbs?
questions.fact: Axolotls can regrow entire legs, tails, and even portions of their heart and brain without scarring!

questions.question: Which of these animals breathes air through a blowhole on the top of its head?
questions.fact: Dolphins and whales are marine mammals that breathe air through blowholes connected directly to their lungs.
